THE REASON BEHIND MERGER

Why we built Merger.

A conversation became an opportunity.
Then it became the reason to build something better.

MERGER / THE JOURNEY

THE FIRST PROBLEM

The inbox was getting overloaded by opportunities from multiple channels.

Conversations arrived on different apps. Every new message added another place to check—and another chance for something important to get buried.

01 / 09

OUR FIRST ANSWER

So we've built a place that helps us keep up.

Bring your connected channels into one inbox. Read and reply from Merger, while each conversation stays on its original messaging service.

02 / 09

THE NEXT PROBLEM

But we still had another problem.

Messages kept coming in, but there was no clear way to organize them by deal. Important details, people, and next steps got buried as conversations moved on.

03 / 09

THE NEXT ANSWER

So we built a system that detects deals as they're sent to you.

With optional AI, Merger can surface deal-related conversations for review. Bring the people, terms and next step into a deal workspace before the opportunity gets lost.

04 / 09

THE VISION · NOT LIVE

Here's our vision with merger.

Our ambition is a professional network where serious dealmakers can discover one another, build relationships and work on opportunities together.

Know who you're dealing with.

We'll utilize KYC/AML verification for users that want access to a verified network. This way, you can spend less time worrying about who you're dealing with and spend more time completing the deal.

A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Make it work
for your workflow.

A clear picture of what you’re connecting, how you get started, and where to find help.

Talk to Merger support ↗
Do my contacts need Merger too?

No. You connect the messaging accounts you already use, and replies go through the original service. Supported accounts, history, and actions vary by service.

Does attaching a chat create a group?

No. Attaching a conversation organizes it in your own deal workspace. It does not invite the people in that conversation to a new group or contact them.

Can I use Merger without AI?

Yes. You can message and organize deals manually. Optional Claude features use your own Anthropic API key, with usage billed separately. You review suggestions before filing a deal.

How is my connected data handled?

Some messaging connections use hosted services. The current privacy policy explains how account information, message content, contacts, and optional AI are handled. Review it before connecting your accounts. Read the privacy policy ↗

Where can I use Merger today?

Merger is available for iPhone and Windows. The iPhone app requires iOS 16.4 or later. Available connections and individual actions may differ by platform.

What do I need to get started?

Create your account on Merger’s website, verify your email, choose a membership, and complete checkout. Then install the app, sign in, and connect the accounts you want to use.
